description_en: Changes the virtual IP address (VIP) that is used to connect to an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-cluster-vip --db-cluster-id amv-2ze8mbuai9700000 --vpc-id vpc-bp1at5ze0t5u3xtqn0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1aadw9k19x6cis90000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBClusterVip

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID.



The new VPC must reside in the same region as the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
专有网络VPC ID。

VPC所在地域与集群属于同一地域
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID.



The new vSwitch must reside in the same zone as the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟交换机ID。
传入的新虚拟交换机必须与集群属于同一个可用区
parameters.name: vswitch_id
